title: First-wave execution preflight

evidence: experiments/run_experiment.py::_build_hardware_model uses hardware_parameters; run_experiment records hardware_model_applied and noise_parameters_applied=false at lines 436-437.

t1_t2.evidence: V3 contains no T1/T2 scenarios; no relaxation or real-hardware claims.

rx_sampling_unit.evidence: One calibrated RX invocation per shot; run_shots loops shots at lines 471-495. Thus 1024 decisions/report. run_shots returns measurement counts and does not expose gate_failed events.

mathematical_observability.evidence: RY(pi/3) on q0 then RX(theta), q0 measured; spectator gates only q1+. All theta are nonzero and <pi/2; combined readout rates <0.5. Exact q0 marginal depends on skip probability.

blockers.finding: The specified report path does not expose realized RX skip counts for its actual 1024 shots. run_circuit computes gate_failed but does not return/persist it; run_shots aggregates only measurement counts. run_circuit_traced exposes gate_failed on a separate path, not the report's sampled shot stream.
blockers.required_correction: Specify and review a way to record every gate skip in the same shot stream that generates the report, without changing production diagnosis behavior; or obtain owner approval to revise requirements and treat realized count as unavailable. Do not infer skips from bitstrings or a second stochastic trace.

blockers.finding: V3 does not specify progress checkpoints, failure classification, resume and duplicate behavior, bounded retries, resource/failure stopping threshold, or final planned/completed/failed/skipped reconciliation. run_experiment writes directly to output path; run_config_batch reruns configs; full_dataset.generate_dataset deletes existing run-*.json files.
blockers.required_correction: Review a protocol with isolated directory creation, deterministic scenario IDs, atomic writes, status log, resume keyed by spec hash and scenario ID, duplicate protection, no silent replacements, bounded/no retries, resource stop threshold, explicit completion condition, and row reconciliation.

reason_deferred: Decision gate failed; generating any scenarios before blocker resolution would violate the user's stop instruction.
